And DOWN (t23-28): the divider didn't move (stayed at 15-17). Interesting — DOWN doesn't move the divider (only LEFT/RIGHT do? Or does the divider only move horizontally?). And SPACE (t29): the divider didn't move (15-17), but the dots changed.
Wait, the divider is at 15-17 both before and after SPACE. But in the earlier diff, the W at column 16 changed to b. So SPACE didn't move the divider; it removed the white dots from the divider and added 8 white dots to the black piece B.
Hmm, wait, but B is at (18-29, 45-59) — that's the black piece on the right side. In the segmentation, 'B' with pixels>30 shows (63,63,0,62,63) — that's the bottom black bar (row 63). So the black piece on the right side is a different color? Let me check: in the current frame's segmentation, which node is at (18-29, 45-59)?

In this latest scan, I filtered by pixels>30 and only output one 'B' — a dict keyed by color! Both nodes have color 'B', so the dict overwrote. That's it.
OK, so the current state:
- Player c: destroyed (gone).
- Divider: 15-17 (axis 16), no white dots.
- Black piece B: (18-29, 45-59), with 8 white dots.
- Yellow Y: (42-53, 3-17).

So the player is dead. The level isn't cleared. What do I do? The player is gone! Can I bring the player back?
Hmm. Maybe SPACE can respawn the player? Or MOUSE click? Or ACTION7?
Wait — maybe I'm wrong about which piece is the player. What if the black piece B is the player (like in level 1 where B was the player), and the gray c is its shadow? In level 1: B (black) = player, c (gray) = shadow. In level 2: B (black) = player, c (gray) = shadow!
Let me re-verify: in level 2, when I pressed LEFT, c (gray) moved 6px to the left and B (black) didn't move. If B were the player, B should have moved. So c is the player in level 2...
But wait, let me actually re-verify. In level 2, t16: c moved from (15-29) to (9-23) — 6 left. B stayed at (45-59). So c moved, B didn't. c is the player.
But in level 1, B moved and c followed. So in level 1, B is the player. In level 2, c is the player. The player's color changed between levels? That's possible — the "player" is the piece that moves with the arrow keys.
So in level 2, the player (gray c) is dead. The level isn't cleared. I need to bring the player back.
Options: SPACE (tried once — dots changed, no respawn), MOUSE (click somewhere?), ACTION7 (unknown).
Let me try ACTION7 or a MOUSE click to see if the player respawns.
Actually wait — maybe the player isn't dead. Maybe the player just went off-screen and can come back if I move RIGHT? The player was at (-9..5, 18-29) — partially off-screen. If I press RIGHT, the player moves 6 right → (-3..11), still partially off-screen. Then RIGHT → (3..17) visible! And the divider moves 3 right → 18-20.
But wait, when the player was at (0-11) (t18), it was visible (63px). At t19 it disappeared. Hmm, at t18 the player was at cols 0-11 (63px, clipped at the left edge). At t19 (5th LEFT) the player should be at (-6..5) → 12px visible... but it disappeared completely.
Hmm, so the player was destroyed at t19. Or the player only disappears when it's more than 50% off-screen? At t19: cols -6..5 → 6 of 15 visible = 40% → destroyed. At t18: 0..11 → 12 of 15 = 80% → survived.
